mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS shows a 3-month average increase of > 200k jobs, the strengthening labor market indicates economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, signaling improved industrial production, enhances economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of non-recession quarters with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, indicating housing market strength, reflects broader economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds a 6-month average increase of 2.5%, signaling rising inflation, investors anticipate potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances with CPIAUCSL above the 2.5% 6mo avg threshold, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when PAYEMS shows a 2-month consecutive decrease and UNRATE rises above 7%, the weakening labor market indicates economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 35% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, signaling rising retail sales, enhances economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during holiday seasons.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of holiday season days with positive RSAFS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3.5-year rolling window.
